response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and platforms, but lacks the specific C++ and Windows platform experience required for the role. Additionally, there is no evidence of domain expertise in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking, nor any mention of SQL Server or Oracle experience. While the candidate has strong communication skills, the mismatch in core technical requirements and domain knowledge makes them a poor fit for this role.
strengths: Strong software development background with experience in multiple languages and platforms
Proven ability to work in agile environments and optimize systems
Demonstrated expertise in full-stack development and dev-ops practices
concerns: No substantial C++ experience on Windows platform (key requirement)
No domain experience in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
Lacks experience with SQL Server or Oracle (mandatory technical skill)
